orbit counting for a cyclic 2-group action
notes: k = 1 + sum_{b=1}^{2^t} 2^{M e_b} with 2^t > n and generic exponents (distinct composition sums, 2^M above all multinomials): s(k^i) = sum over compositions of s(multinomial); the cyclic shift of the 2^t blocks pairs off all compositions except (i,0,...,0) for i < 2^t, so s(k^i) is odd. Witnesses checked directly for n = 1, 3, 7. Outside Lean: the whole construction and orbit-count argument, written out in the README.
